clippings.speaker: Harrison Ford
clippings.quote: I suppose you can just simply say that I love him. You know, he’s a bit of a mystery, old George. I mean, he’s got a head so crammed full of ideas and thoughts and ambitions, and yet at his heart he’s simply a father, a husband, a mentor, business man, an entrepreneur, a creative genius — just a guy. … And he’s my friend.
clippings.title: Harrison Ford on 'The Force Awakens' and the Return of Han Solo
clippings.context: Asked by Brian Hiatt what he made of Lucas then and now, around the release of The Force Awakens.

clippings.speaker: Harrison Ford
clippings.quote: I was not an overnight success. I struggled for about 15 years, going from acting job to carpentry and back to acting. Until I finally got a part in a wildly successful film. None of this happened on my own. Thank you, George Lucas. Thank you, Steven Spielberg.
clippings.title: Harrison Ford thanks Star Wars creator George Lucas for giving him "a part in a wildly successful film" during emotional SAG awards speech
clippings.context: From Ford's acceptance speech for the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award on March 1, 2026.

clippings.speaker: George Lucas
clippings.quote: He got the part because in the end I asked him, this is about spaceships and flying and stuff like that. I said ‘Do you know how to fly?’
clippings.title: '40 Years Of Star Wars' Panel: George Lucas Says "There Aren't That Many People Like" Carrie Fisher
clippings.context: Same Celebration panel; Ford replied, "I said, fly, yeah. Land?"

clippings.speaker: George Lucas
clippings.quote: I was wary of Harrison and I becoming like Scorsese and De Niro. I thought, "Let's create a new icon."
clippings.title: The Making Of Raiders Of The Lost Ark
clippings.context: Lucas in Empire's oral history of Raiders, on why he first looked beyond Ford to play Indiana Jones.

clippings.speaker: George Lucas
clippings.quote: So then we were running short of time and Steven said, "There's always Harrison." I doubted he'd go for a three-picture deal - he didn't want to on Star Wars. … I went to Harrison and he read the script and said, "Yeah, I'll do a three-picture deal. I'd love to."
clippings.title: The Making Of Raiders Of The Lost Ark
clippings.context: Lucas in Empire's oral history, on how Ford came to play Indiana Jones after Tom Selleck dropped out.

notes: Rolling Stone US redirects to a paywall gate, so the Australian edition was used. Empire's oral history (2021) gathers interviews of uncertain date, so said_year is null. Skipped a Yahoo 'first impression' piece that looked unreliable.
